test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'issued**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Issue** means **to deliver or to publish**.

 
 
• Example - ***This book was issued by the library in-charge***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, The Ministry of Defence
